note: West Carroll Parish (22123) publishes no queryable public parcel service or file. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for West Carroll parcels return only unrelated items (school board and police jury redistricting maps, parish boundaries). Assessor and GIS portal pages name no ArcGIS endpoint, only the assessor's office (Oak Grove) and website-only access. usparcelmaps.com lists West Carroll only as a 'no viewer' page. Parcel data is sold commercially (mappingsolutionsgis.com, \$300) or shown through third-party viewers (acres.com, acrevalue.com) with no public service.
